soundness_flags.label: ass:complete-predecessor-functions
soundness_flags.one_line: The condition fixes every structural map to the full predecessor product, which is a complete canonical saturation rather than the standard meaning of a recursive SCM merely compatible with a total order.

soundness_flags.label: ass:wellformed-contexts
soundness_flags.one_line: Predecessor-only retained contexts are already guaranteed by def:query-normalizer and lem:query-normalization, so this should be a derived interface invariant rather than an independent assumption.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 2–4, §§2–3, especially lines 64–72 and 157–166 of the primary PDF text
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines a recursive SCM with parent sets as subsets of endogenous variables, then separately introduces a complete canonical PSCM whose variables use all predecessors and one shared exogenous variable; its Theorems 1–4 establish the response-signature and lifted-LP reductions and attainment.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 1, Abstract and Introduction, lines 7–18 and 31–49
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper compiles a fixed underlying model into an arithmetic circuit to accelerate iterated-EM inner approximations while structural equations and topology are shared across repeated queries.

The paper studies satisfiability for linear combinations of counterfactual probability terms and records FPT in domain size plus number of variables for SAT^lin_counterfact; it is not an exact partial-identification compiler from a fixed observational law.

The paper reduces counterfactual bounding under an arbitrary causal diagram and observational/experimental distributions to canonical finite SCMs and polynomial programs yielding optimal bounds, with Monte Carlo approximation for computation.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Retag ass:complete-predecessor-functions as the complete canonical order-only response carrier and prove or cite the explicit equivalence from arbitrary order-compatible SCMs before invoking it; do not call saturation the standard recursive-SCM assumption.
Delete ass:wellformed-contexts from the maintained assumptions and state predecessor-only legality as the output guarantee of the normalizer lemma, threading that lemma into each compiler theorem.

Add a worked non-binary or large-alphabet instance that reports the Rossetto–Antonucci lifted-state count beside the exact h-context state count, including the jointly scored case, to make the claimed strict computational separation independently auditable.

Sharpen the residual-minimality OEQ with an explicit candidate partition pair and causal suffix distinguisher family, or a stated coarsening candidate, so it becomes a focused Bell-frontier program rather than a broad dichotomy.

recommended_next_step: Revise the two assumption/interface defects, then advance the field-tier equality-partition compiler kernel to Stage 0 with its computational comparison to Rossetto–Antonucci retained as the central novelty claim.
